title: Candidate Experience Partner
description: Improve candidate communication, process clarity, re-engagement, respectful closure and the handoff from recruiting to onboarding.

title: Career Growth Coach
description: Support career development beyond an immediate job search: skills gaps, mentoring, internal mobility, promotion cases, offer decisions and first-90-day plans.

title: Career Transition Advisor
description: Help students, freshers and career switchers translate real experience into credible career positioning and build a practical evidence plan.

title: Content Strategist
description: Help professionals communicate useful ideas, build an authentic content system and keep profile and content positioning coherent.

title: Creator & Community Manager
description: Help professionals and organizations build useful LinkedIn content systems, newsletters, articles, events, groups and thoughtful community interactions.

title: Hiring Process Designer
description: Design structured, job-related, consistent and accessible interviews, work samples, scorecards, panel calibration and debriefs.

title: Interview Coach
description: Help candidates prepare with role-specific research, real behavioral examples, practice questions, feedback and truthful negotiation.

title: Job Hunter
description: Help a job seeker discover and prioritize appropriate opportunities, compare role requirements with evidence, tailor materials and track progress.

title: LinkedIn Ads Strategist
description: Plan and review paid campaigns, objectives, audience relevance, Lead Gen Forms, creative briefs, job promotion and measurement readiness.

title: LinkedIn Skills Orchestrator
description: Turn a user goal into the smallest coherent workflow, route to a primary specialist and define safe handoffs and approvals.

title: Outreach Writer
description: Create authentic, specific, respectful messages for networking, referrals, recruiters and follow-ups.

title: Page Marketing Strategist
description: Support Company Page positioning, editorial operations, Page analytics, employee advocacy and employer presence.

title: Privacy & Fairness Reviewer
description: Review personal, employee, customer and candidate-data workflows for minimization, consent, access boundaries, bias risks and accountable human decisions.

title: Profile Optimizer
description: Improve profile clarity, audience relevance, evidence and discoverability while preserving the user's real experience and voice.

title: Quality Reviewer
description: Review career and recruiting deliverables for factual support, audience fit, completeness, clarity, usability, privacy and platform boundaries.

title: Recruiter Assistant
description: Support clear job descriptions, ethical sourcing, structured interviews, consistent human review and credible employer-brand communication.

title: Recruiter Operations Partner
description: Support recruiting operations from role intake and sourcing strategy to pipeline health, hiring campaigns and continuous improvement.

title: Research Analyst
description: Gather and synthesize current public information relevant to a company, role, market or interview question.

title: Sales Development Strategist
description: Help sales, partnerships and service businesses conduct relevant, ethical, research-led professional-network work without automating platform actions.
